title: National Health Insurance Data as a Research Tool in Korean Medicine: a guide to database utilization and methodological approaches.
figures: Composition and use of the National Health Information DB.  Figure 1  illustrates the comprehensive structure of the National Health Information DB and its relationship with various data sources. The diagram shows how different types of healthcare data (qualification, medical treatment, health examination, and long-term care data) are collected, processed, and made available for research purposes.
